title: nf-dnaseq pipeline parameters
description: Germline short variant calling (per-sample + joint genotyping) with Samtools and GATK4

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to a comma-separated samplesheet listing the input BAM files.
input.help_text: CSV with a header row and two columns: `sample_id,reads_bam`. See `assets/schema_input.json` for the exact row schema and `assets/samplesheet.csv` for a template.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be published.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome and accessory files required for variant calling.

reference.description: Path to the reference genome FASTA file.

reference_index.description: Path to the reference genome FASTA index (.fai), e.g. generated with `samtools faidx`.

reference_dict.description: Path to the reference genome sequence dictionary (.dict), e.g. generated with `gatk CreateSequenceDictionary`.

intervals.description: BED file of genomic intervals to restrict variant calling to.

cohort_name.description: Base name used for the final joint-genotyped cohort VCF (<cohort_name>.joint.vcf).

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options, typically set via a config file or profile rather than the command line.

help.description: Display the help message and exit.
